signals.summary: Fashion press is reframing hiking gear as a cool-girl style category, pushing technical outdoor apparel into the mainstream aesthetic conversation for summer 2026.
signals.why_now: Two independent fashion/news outlets in the last ~15 hours (E! News on 'gorpcore', Harper's Bazaar on a fashion-adjacent hiking brand at 6.8h), on top of sustained coverage across CN Traveller, Who What Wear, USA Today and The Zoe Report over prior months.

signals.summary: A naturalistic, low-effort gardening wave (chaos gardening, scatter-sowing, native plants, wildflower meadows) is the dominant lifestyle-garden narrative this season.
signals.why_now: A broad seasonal wave carried by at least seven independent outlets - NYT, Tom's Guide, Realtor.com, Axios, Good Housekeeping, House Beautiful and ELLE Decor - all framing low-effort naturalistic planting as the 2026 summer trend; evergreen for the growing season though no single item is fresh in the last 48h.

signals.summary: The barely-there technical hiking sandal is being crowned a fashion staple for summer, bridging trail gear and everyday style.
signals.why_now: Two independent fashion outlets frame the hiking sandal as this summer's must-have - Harper's Bazaar on a viral $50 sandal (82.5h) and Vogue declaring it the 'official shoe of the summer' - a seasonal product wave that photographs cleanly as an object.
